about_the_game:
Story

In Murino Adventures, you play as Drun and Ch — two survivors lost in the decaying district of Murino.
A mysterious phenomenon known as the Fog is spreading, twisting space and time, erasing entire blocks and memories.

Once lively courtyards are now silent. Towering gigahruščëvkas rise over empty streets, and something moves behind broken windows.
Your mission is simple: survive, escape Murino, or destroy the Fog from within.

As you explore, you’ll uncover traces of Mellstroy’s forgotten experiments and learn the horrifying truth behind Murino’s isolation.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric World – Explore gloomy courtyards, collapsing Khrushchyovkas, and labyrinthine basements.
  • Two Playable Characters – Switch between Drun and Ch, each with unique perspectives and abilities.
  • The Fog System – A living entity that changes environments and affects your sanity.
  • Co-op Survival – Work together, share scarce supplies, and survive the night.
  • Urban Legends & Lore – Discover what really happened to Murino and how Melstroy is involved.
  • Multiple Endings – Your choices determine the fate of Drun, Ch, and the city itself.

Characters

Drun — calm, analytical, sensitive to echoes of the past.
Ch — bold, emotional, able to resist the Fog’s psychological influence for a short time.

Gameplay Notes

  • The Fog reacts to noise and light. Stay quiet, move carefully.
  • Each player sees the world slightly differently — communication is key.
  • Exploring hidden zones can reveal the truth... or something worse.

“In Murino, even silence has an echo.”

name: Murino

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (or newer, if your PC survived 2020)
  • Processor: Anything that doesn’t catch fire when hearing the word “shader”
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: A card from Monopoly
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any, as long as it doesn’t scream
  • VR Support: Works if you wear a cooking pot on your head
  • Additional Notes: Runs faster if you offer your PC a cup of coffee ☕
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 Pro (Battle-Hardened Edition)
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-9000K or better — check NASA’s warehouse
  • Memory: 128 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 5090 Titan Unicorn Edition
  • Storage: 120 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dolby Atmos integrated directly into your brain
  • VR Support: Only if you’re ready to lose touch with reality
  • Additional Notes: Boosts FPS when you shout “LET’S GOOOO” in CAPS LOCK
